```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(eval = FALSE, collapse = TRUE, comment = "#>")
```

## Use a real case

Examples require a completed real-data case. Set `CAST_REAL_CASE` to its directory.
The vignette build does not create measurements, labels or artificial scenarios.

```{r case}
library(castSDM)
case_dir <- Sys.getenv("CAST_REAL_CASE")
run <- readRDS(file.path(case_dir, "training", "result.rds"))
split <- readRDS(file.path(case_dir, "training", "stages", "01_prepare.rds"))
comparison <- readRDS(file.path(case_dir, "comparison", "comparison.rds"))
```

## Screen and fit

The default uses conventional VIF <= 10 inside each training fold, with no
predictor-count target. VIF is a redundancy diagnostic, not importance or causality.
The case workflow uses RF, standard linear/quadratic MaxEnt, and GAM with BAM.

```{r selection}
selection <- cast_select(split$train, method = "vif", vif_threshold = 10)
selection$diagnostics$vif_log
fit <- cast_fit(split$train, screen = selection,
  models = c("rf", "maxent", "gam"), maxent_classes = "lq", gam_backend = "bam")
```

For a new full analysis, initialise the workflow with actual source paths through
`cast_workflow()`, or open the no-code setup form with `cast_app()`. Review its
input checks before clicking Run. Future scenarios use real CHELSA ensemble-mean
climate; nonclimate predictors are held current. Scenario mean climate does not
represent between-GCM uncertainty.

## Explain and inspect

```{r inspect}
cast_app(case_dir)
cast_diagnose(run, comparison)
```

Select an imported scenario, inspect environment-response summaries, and request
one factor map. Explicit hypothetical shifts are in original units and show the
observed training range. No intervention magnitude is generated automatically.
The interface displays driver-only and retained responses, marginal support,
and agreement between engines. These are fitted suitability responses, not
identified ecological causal effects or occurrence probabilities.

If no fitted predictor changes, the program reports that the model cannot
assess the supplied changes. Identical predictions do not prove ecological
stability. Current predictions and observed response profiles remain available.

## Complete publication outputs

```{r figures}
cast_figures(run, comparison, output_dir = file.path(case_dir, "figures"),
  include = "all")
```

Keep actual predictor stacks available for per-factor maps and native-grid MESS,
or reuse their verified saved products. Complete selection/inclusion catalogues
are paginated; overview plots are not an alternative to the full source tables.
